description: Registro pubblico append-only. Pubblica solo prove minimizzate (name/nickname + hash + timestamp). Nessuna custodia pubblica di dati personali. Verifica deterministica: se non matcha -> INVALID (fail-closed).

constraints.name: public display name (Nome Cognome or approved abbreviated form)

schema.compatibility: UI must render entry.name if present, else entry.nickname (legacy). Matching uses payload_sha256 only.
